stopPoints.label: Pororo and Petty are walking in the beautiful snowy forest
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'Look at the trees. Is it sunny ☀️ or snowing ❄️?'
Guidance: 'It's sunny! There is white snow on the trees.'

stopPoints.label: Poby is stretching out and waking up in his bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is Poby waking up?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he is. B) No, he isn't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, he is waking up! Good morning!'

stopPoints.label: Harry is sitting on Poby's head outside the house
stopPoints.question:
Question (Who): 'Who is on Poby's head? Is it Harry 🐦 or Pororo?'
Guidance: 'It's Harry! He came very early to see the flying plane!'

stopPoints.label: Eddy is driving a small handmade silver plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'What is Eddy driving? A car 🚗 or a plane ✈️?'
Guidance: 'It's a plane! Eddy is driving his new silver plane on the snow.'

stopPoints.label: Pororo, Eddy, and Crong are smiling happily together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'Look at their faces. Are they happy 😊 or sad 😢?'
Guidance: 'They are happy! They are smiling together because the plane is ready!'

stopPoints.label: The friends look disappointed after the plane falls down
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Oh no! Did the plane crash?'
Options: 'A) Yes, it did. B) No, it didn't.'
Guidance: Help the child say: 'Yes, the plane crashed! Oh no!'

stopPoints.label: The small silver plane is stuck high up in the tree branches
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the plane now? Is it on the tree 🌲 or on the river 💧?'
Guidance: 'It's on the tree! The plane crashed into the tree!'

stopPoints.label: Eddy shows a new, big, beautiful blue rocket plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Look at the new plane! Is it red 🔴 or blue 🔵?'
Guidance: 'It's blue! Eddy made a more powerful blue plane!'

stopPoints.label: Fire and bright light blast out from the back of the blue plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'Look at the power! Can you see fire 🔥 or water 💧?'
Guidance: 'It's fire! The plane is getting ready to take off with strong power!'

stopPoints.label: The blue plane crashes into a big snowy white mountain
stopPoints.question:
Question (Place): 'Where did they crash this time? Into a mountain 🏔️ or a house 🏠?'
Guidance: 'This time they crashed into a mountain!'

stopPoints.label: The blue rocket plane is flying high up into the outer space
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the plane flying? To the park 🌲 or to outer space 🚀?'
Guidance: 'To outer space! Look at the big planet behind them!'

stopPoints.label: The blue plane hits a large purple unidentified flying object
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'What did they hit in space? A giant ball ⚽ or a UFO 🛸?'
Guidance: 'They crashed into a UFO! Look at the big round purple object!'

stopPoints.label: The friends are checking the broken computer inside the UFO
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is the UFO broken?'
Options: 'A) Yes, it is. B) No, it isn't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, it is broken! Look at the blue sparks!'

stopPoints.label: The friends are hiding behind the trees looking scared
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'Look at Pororo and friends. Are they scared 😨 or happy 🎉?'
Guidance: 'They are scared! They are looking at the space friends carefully!'

stopPoints.label: Popo looks very sad while Pipi smiles happily next to him
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'Look at the blue friend Popo. Is he happy 😄 or sad 😢?'
Guidance: 'He is sad! Popo is sad because their UFO is broken!'

stopPoints.label: The cozy little wooden house looks warm under the night sky
stopPoints.question:
Question (Time): 'Is it morning ☀️ or night 🌙?'
Guidance: 'It's night! It is getting late and the sky is dark blue.'

stopPoints.label: Loopy is smiling and holding a big plate full of fresh cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'What did Loopy make for the friends? Cake 🎂 or cookies 🍪?'
Guidance: 'Cookies! Yummy cookies on a plate!'

stopPoints.label: Popo is holding a special star-shaped cookie on his head
stopPoints.question:
Question (Shape): 'What shape is this cookie? Is it a circle ⚪ or a star ⭐?'
Guidance: 'It's a star! A golden star cookie!'

stopPoints.label: Popo and Pipi are happily eating the delicious cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Are the space friends eating 😋 or running 🏃?'
Guidance: 'They are eating! They like the cookies very much!'

stopPoints.label: All the friends sit around the table eating and smiling together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are they all good friends now?'
Options: 'A) Yes, they are. B) No, they aren't.'
Guidance: Cheer together: 'Yes! They became good friends instantly!'
